What You’d Notice Picking This Up Cold

Item E2 is a silver hex flange bolt with a yellow patch on the threads. Five features stand out before you ever read the print.

Hex Flange BoltIndent HeadNo SerrationsSilver FinishYellow Scotch-Grip

No Serrations — the underside of the flange is smooth, not serrated, so it seats flat against the joint without biting into the surface.

Indent Head — the hex head carries an indent on its top face, shown on the print as part of the head design.

Silver Finish — a bright silver Geomet 321 coating with an ML top-coat over the alloy steel.

Hex Flange Bolt — a hex head with an integral flange that acts as a built-in washer, spreading the clamping load over a wider area.

Yellow Scotch-Grip — pre-applied adhesive patch on the thread. The adhesive activates on assembly, bonding the external thread to the internal thread of the nut or tapped hole, which keeps the parts from loosening in vibration.

Tap an orange dot to see what that feature is.

  • Hex Flange Bolt — a hex head with an integral flange that acts as a built-in washer, spreading the clamping load over a wider area.

  • Yellow Scotch-Grip — pre-applied adhesive patch on the thread. The adhesive activates on assembly, bonding the external thread to the internal thread of the nut or tapped hole, which keeps the parts from loosening in vibration.

Topic T5 · Surface Treatment

Geomet 321 + ML Top-Coat

The “GEO321ML” in the part number calls out this specific finish system.

Requirement

With Geomet 321 + Plus ML clear · ASTM F1136M-11, Grade 5, NC (non-chrome) · 720 hours without red rust at SST (ASTM B117).SST: salt spray test. ASTM F1136/F1136M is the standard specification for zinc/aluminum corrosion protective coatings for fasteners.

Typical Call-Out

Geomet 321 + ML Clear Sealer per ASTM F1136M-11, Grade 5, NC.

The finish call-out as it appears on the print: Geomet 321 + Plus ML clear, ASTM F1136M-11 Grade 5 NC, 720 hours without red rust at SST (ASTM B117).

Meaning

Used on carbon steel fasteners, GEOMET 321 is a patented coating. It is best specified on high-hardness material because its permeable surface mitigates the risk of hydrogen embrittlement (HE). The PLUS ML top-coat adds lubricity to ease assembly and avoid cold welding.Hydrogen embrittlement: loss of ductility in high-strength steel that can lead to sudden brittle failure. Coatings that let hydrogen escape lower the risk.

What the Finish Does
  • A patented coating for carbon steel fasteners — the “GEO321” in the part number.
  • Permeable surface — helps mitigate hydrogen-embrittlement risk, which is why it suits a 12.9 part.
  • ML top-coat — provides lubricity so the bolt assembles smoothly and avoids cold welding.
  • Proven by test — 720 hours of salt spray without red rust, Grade 5 non-chrome (NC).

Topic T6 · Extra Thread Locking Treatment

The Yellow Scotch-Grip Patch

The “/SY” suffix calls out a pre-applied adhesive patch on the threads — and a live supplier deviation worth knowing about.

Requirement

With Yellow Scotch-Grip 3M 2353Y, or Red ND Microspheres 593S (as per global BRP deviation), per IFI 525.BRP: a customer of SBS’s (Bombardier Recreational Products). IFI 525: the industry standard for this type of thread patch.

(1) 3M Scotch-Grip 2353

Yellow color. The original, standard callout.

(2) ND 593S Microspheres

Red color. Accepted as a global BRP deviation.

Why the Deviation Exists Active Deviation

3M discontinued Scotch-Grip 2353Y. SBS temporarily accepts the global BRP deviation to replace it with ND 593S Microspheres Red.

Performance Standard

Must comply with IFI 525 (Metric Adhesive Coated Prevailing-Torque Screws).

How a Thread Locker Stops Vibrational Loosening

  1. The problem. Vibration makes the mating threads slip sideways by tiny amounts. Each slip lets the screw turn back a little, clamp load drops, and the joint works loose.
  2. The patch activates on assembly. As the bolt is driven in, the pre-applied adhesive is crushed between the external and internal threads and fills the gap.
  3. The bond holds. Once cured, the adhesive bonds the threads together and resists turning, so the fastener keeps its clamp load under vibration.
Print note 3: a portion of the threads must be coated with 3M Scotch-Grip 2353Y per IFI 525, and detailed test results must be available.

Reference

Glossary

Every code, acronym, and standard used in this module, defined in plain language. Tap a term’s “jump” button to see it in context.

ASTM F1136/F1136M

The standard specification for zinc/aluminum corrosion protective coatings for fasteners. Grade 5, NC (non-chrome) is the grade called out for this part.

BRP

Bombardier Recreational Products — one of SBS’s customers. A “BRP deviation” is a substitution approved specifically for their orders, not a change to the part in general.

Class 12.9

A property class for high-strength, heat-treated alloy steel fasteners: 1200 MPa tensile strength and 385–435 HV (39–44 HRC) hardness. Defined in ISO 898-1.

Control Plan

A document that defines what is measured at each stage of production, with what method and how often.

DIN 6921

The German standard that defines hexagon flange bolts — the head shape, integral flange and dimensions this part is built to. SBS’s Standards Library lists it as withdrawn and replaced by DIN EN 1665.

FMEA

Failure Mode and Effects Analysis — a structured review of what could go wrong at each process step and how it is prevented or detected.

Geomet 321

A patented zinc/aluminum flake coating used on carbon steel fasteners. Its permeable surface helps mitigate hydrogen-embrittlement risk on high-hardness steel.

Hydrogen Embrittlement (HE)

A loss of ductility in high-strength steel that can lead to sudden brittle failure. Coatings with a permeable surface lower the risk.

IFI 525

Metric Adhesive Coated Prevailing-Torque Screws — the Industrial Fasteners Institute standard covering pre-applied thread-locking patches like the one on this part.

ISO 898-1

The international standard for the mechanical properties of bolts, screws and studs made of carbon steel and alloy steel, by property class. It is where the Class 12.9 requirements are defined.

ML Top-Coat

The “PLUS ML” clear sealer applied over Geomet. It provides lubricity to ease assembly and avoid cold welding.

ND 593S Microspheres

A red adhesive thread-locking patch accepted under the global BRP deviation as a replacement for the discontinued yellow Scotch-Grip 2353Y.

PPAP

Production Part Approval Process — the documentation package a supplier submits to prove its process can reliably make a part to print before full production begins.

PSW (Part Submission Warrant)

The signed cover document of a PPAP package — the formal sign-off that a part is approved for production.

Scotch-Grip

The 3M brand name of the yellow adhesive thread-locking patch (2353Y) pre-applied to this part’s threads. 3M has discontinued it.

SST (Salt Spray Test)

The corrosion test defined in ASTM B117. This part must run 720 hours without red rust.

VMI (Vendor-Managed Inventory)

A bin system where SBS manages and restocks parts directly at the customer’s location. This training module is named after Item E2’s cell on the VMI bin card.
